decisions.reason: As a close-to-core workflow machine that uses existing capabilities and remains part of our integrated offering, it is likely to meet or approach our aspiration level, so we keep it unless clearer shortfalls emerge.

Because the orthopedic shoe last is distant from our core customers and routines, weak or uncertain results are less likely to justify continued commitment, and resources are better redirected to core business and new development.
The post-curing unit closely complements our digital production system, and with organisational slack in a growing innovative business we keep it while its performance becomes clearer.
